-- Transaction-only metadata requires no contract-table access/coverage.
SELECT table_name, partition_id, SUM(total_rows) AS total_rows,
       SUM(total_logical_bytes) AS total_logical_bytes,
       MAX(last_modified_time) AS last_modified_time
FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.PARTITIONS`
WHERE table_name = 'transactions'
  AND partition_id >= FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', @start)
  AND partition_id < FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', @end)
GROUP BY table_name, partition_id
ORDER BY table_name, partition_id

-- One source transaction row per signed transaction; includes all statuses.
-- COUNT(*) must agree with the earlier transaction partition row metadata.
SELECT block_date AS date, COUNT(*) AS transactions,
       COUNT(DISTINCT signer_account_id) AS signers,
       COUNTIF(signer_account_id IS NULL) AS missing_signers,
       COUNT(DISTINCT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM block_timestamp_utc)) AS observed_hours
FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.transactions`
WHERE block_date >= @start AND block_date < @end
GROUP BY block_date
ORDER BY block_date

completeness_policy: Elapsed UTC days; positive executed daily table counts; 24-hour coverage; partition row-count comparison when metadata is accessible. Only a specific metadata-view 403 permits omission of that comparison. This does not prove absence of upstream indexing omissions.

schema.name: block_date
schema.description: The date of the Block. Used to partition the table

schema.name: block_timestamp
schema.description: The timestamp of the Block in nanoseconds

schema.name: block_timestamp_utc
schema.description: The timestamp of the Block in UTC

schema.name: shard_id
schema.description: The shard ID of the Chunk

schema.name: signer_account_id
schema.description: An account on which behalf transaction is signed

schema.name: signer_public_key
schema.description: An access key which was used to sign a transaction

schema.name: nonce
schema.description: Nonce is used to determine order of transaction in the pool. It increments for a combination of `signer_id` and `public_key`

schema.name: signature
schema.description: A signature of a hash of the Borsh-serialized Transaction

schema.name: converted_into_receipt_id
schema.description: Receipt ID that the transaction was converted.

schema.name: receipt_conversion_gas_burnt
schema.description: Gas burnt in the receipt conversion

schema.name: receipt_conversion_tokens_burnt
schema.description: Tokens burnt in the receipt conversion
